must_measure: Payor design chosen by each pilot employer
numerator: Employers in each of: employer-paid; employee-paid voluntary; hybrid/shared
denominator: Pilot employers offered a documented design
why_it_is_not_optional: M9a. Take-up is uninterpretable without this mix.

must_measure: Covered-lives weight of each payor cell
numerator: Eligible employees in each payor cell
denominator: All eligible employees in the pilot book
why_it_is_not_optional: Employer-count mix and lives mix can diverge; lives are what Charter's print cares about.

numerator: Employees who meet the written eligibility rule (hours/class/waiting period) AND were shown the offer
why_it_is_not_optional: Do not use 'all employees' as the denominator if the ballot was only shown to some classes.

numerator: Eligible employees who supplied a residential address
why_it_is_not_optional: Take-up of an ISP product requires an address; a benefits click without an address is not an internet account.

numerator: Internet accounts opened or transferred under the offer (one per employee)
denominator: P3 eligibles; also P4 address-captured as a sensitivity
why_it_is_not_optional: This is M9b. Time-box it. Do not leave the window open indefinitely and call it a rate.

numerator: P5 enrollments in each M9a cell
why_it_is_not_optional: The split. Never headline a blend.

numerator: Dollar employee pays per month and dollar employer pays per month
denominator: Per enrolled account and per eligible (offered price)
why_it_is_not_optional: Price is the lever that makes voluntary take-up move; a $0 employer-paid line is a different product from a $70/month voluntary line.

numerator: Employees citing already-have-adequate; already-Spectrum; out of footprint; price; hassle; do not want employer in the home
why_it_is_not_optional: Separates 'did not elect' from M5 footprint fail and M6 already-adequate. Privacy: no usage monitoring.

numerator: Enrollees matched to an active Spectrum residential account at t-1
why_it_is_not_optional: Enrollment is not a net add. M13 owns the net-add arithmetic; M9 must not count transfers as proof of election-to-new.

numerator: n/a — a pair of pre-committed floors (M9a employer-paid share; M9b voluntary take-up)
when: Before the first employee sees a ballot
why_it_is_not_optional: A floor written after seeing the rate is decoration.
